_readme: Verified service catalog. Data role owns this file. Every value must trace to data/sources.md. verified=true ONLY when the fee/deadline/link was read on the authority's own official page (see 'Verification pass' in sources.md). Records from media or third-party guides stay verified=false, and the app shows a warning for them.

services.fee_note: The amount printed on the fine, plus AED 20 Knowledge and Innovation fees per fine.
services.deadline_rule: The official RTA service page lists no early-payment discount and no payment deadline. Unpaid fines must be paid before renewing a driving licence or vehicle ownership.
next_steps: Open the RTA website or the RTA Dubai / Dubai Now app and go to Fines Enquiry and Payment
Enter your details (for example plate number or traffic file) or log in with UAE Pass
Check the amount matches the paper, pay by card, and keep the receipt sent by email
services.source: RTA, Pay Vehicle Fines service page (official)
services.legal_basis: Regulation No. (7) of 2006 on traffic control rules and procedures in the Emirate of Dubai (as listed for Dubai Police traffic fines in the Dubai Government Service Prices dataset)

services.fee_note: The amount printed on the fine. No extra service fee was found.
services.deadline_rule: No payment deadline is listed. Check the amount in the TAMM or Abu Dhabi Police app before paying.
next_steps: Open the TAMM or Abu Dhabi Police app or website (log in with UAE Pass)
Search for the fine using your plate number, licence number or Emirates ID
Check the amount shown in the app matches your fine, then pay online
services.source: TAMM: Pay traffic fines (official service page). The page only loads in a browser, so it could not be checked automatically.

services.service_name: Renewing a residence permit (private sector), GDRFA Dubai
services.fee_note: For private-sector residence renewal, GDRFA lists: AED 200 renewal fee, AED 10 Knowledge Dirham, AED 10 Innovation Dirham, AED 20 delivery, and an AED 500 'fee inside the country'. The fee rises by AED 100 per year for residence longer than two years. Other visa categories have different fees: check the exact total on GDRFA before paying.
services.deadline_rule: Grace period: 60 days after the residence permit expires or is cancelled (GDRFA, private sector). After the grace period, the federal overstay fine is AED 50 per day (ICP).
next_steps: Open the GDRFA Dubai website or app and log in with UAE Pass
Find the renewal service that matches your visa type and apply
Pay the fees before the grace period ends to avoid daily overstay fines
services.source: GDRFA Dubai service page (official); ICP 'Payment of visa or residence violation fine' (official)
services.legal_basis: Cabinet Resolution No. 22 of 2014 on regulating and developing nationality, residency and ports services (Dubai Government Service Prices dataset, fee GDRF-0026914: renewal of a residence permit for a private-sector or free-zone employee)

items.label: Overstay
items.note: Charged per day after the grace period ends (ICP, official).

services.authority: ICP (Federal Authority for Identity, Citizenship, Customs and Port Security)
services.fee_note: AED 100 application fee + AED 100 for each year of residence + AED 100 smart service fee.
services.deadline_rule: Grace period after expiry or cancellation depends on the category: 180 days (Golden, Green and Blue residence holders and their families, students after finishing their studies, and some family categories), 90 days (skilled workers levels 1-3 and property owners), 60 days (permits with a guarantor or host), 30 days (all other categories). After the grace period: AED 50 fine per day.
next_steps: Open the ICP smart services website or the UAEICP app and log in with UAE Pass
Choose 'Renewal of residency permits', check the pre-filled data and attach documents if asked
Pay the fees before your grace period ends
services.source: ICP 'Renewal of residency permits' and 'Payment of visa or residence violation fine' service pages (official); u.ae residence visa provisions (official)

services.fee_note: AED 177.75 through the Dubai REST app or DLD website (AED 100 registration + AED 10 knowledge + AED 10 innovation + AED 55 service partner fee + AED 2.75 VAT). AED 220 at a Real Estate Services Trustee Centre. This is the Ejari registration fee, not the rent.
services.deadline_rule: The official DLD page gives no deadline for registering. The same service is used to register a new contract or renew an existing one.
next_steps: Check the contract dates, yearly rent and number of cheques match what you agreed
Register (or renew) the contract in Ejari through the Dubai REST app, the DLD website, Dubai Now, or a Trustee Centre
Keep a copy of the Ejari certificate
services.source: Dubai Land Department, Register / Renew Tenancy Contract service page (official)
services.legal_basis: Executive Council Resolution No. (25) of 2009 approving the fees of the Real Estate Regulatory Agency (Dubai Government Service Prices dataset, fee DLD-0020607: tenancy contract registration fee)
